snippet.title: DeadCore Redux Launch trailer
snippet.description:
DeadCore is OUT TODAY!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3484260/DeadCore_Redux/
DeadCore Redux is a challenging FPS-platformer set in a futuristic universe. Chain precise jumps, manipulate mechanisms with your SwitchGun, hunt hidden collectibles and new shortcuts, and push your skills to the limit as you climb a colossal Tower born from the void. Will you reach the Summit?
https://5bitsgames.com/
Join our Discord : https://discord.gg/fpbBeqgu9u
https://bsky.app/profile/5bitsgames.com
